summary: Backend: 14/14 pytest tests PASSED covering hubs, idempotent register, ride pool creation, second-request pool join with fare recompute, /rides/available, driver accept + in_progress promotion, verify-pin (correct/wrong), complete, passenger + driver history. Frontend: Onboarding works (both roles, driver reveals vehicle input, 10-digit phone validation enforced). Passenger home: pickup/dropoff selectors open hub-picker modal (testIDs are 'hub-hub-{hubId}', not 'hub-option-{hubId}'), vehicle-auto/cab toggles present, find-ride-btn navigates to /passenger/matching?requestId=... where matching-state, route-pickup, route-dropoff, cancel-ride-btn render correctly with 'Your fare share ₹143 · Total ₹143 · 5.51 km · Split across 1 rider'. Driver flow blocked: clicking online-toggle did not flip state (button still shows 'Offline', accept-ride-{id} cards not rendered) so pin-input-{pid}, verify-pin-{pid}, complete-ride-btn and share-trip-btn were not reachable via UI (backend equivalents work fine).

ui_bugs.issue: Tapping [data-testid="online-toggle"] via Playwright does not switch driver to Online — pill still reads 'Offline' and ride cards remain hidden ('You are offline' state). Incoming shared rides count updates (1) so /rides/available is polled, but toggle state doesn't flip. May be a Pressable/state binding issue or requires double-tap. Blocks manual driver acceptance UI testing.

integration_issues.flow: Driver accept → Passenger matching sees PIN & share-trip-btn
integration_issues.issue: Could not verify pin-display and share-trip-btn on matching screen because driver-side accept UI is blocked by online-toggle bug. Backend /rides/shared/{id}/accept works correctly (see pytest).

issues: testIDs use pattern 'hub-hub-{id}' (double 'hub-') — consider renaming to 'hub-option-{id}' for clarity and to match request spec.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warnings: 'shadow*' style props deprecated → use 'boxShadow'; 'TouchableWithoutFeedback is deprecated → use Pressable'. Non-blocking.

action_items: Fix driver online-toggle: verify onPress handler correctly flips online state and re-renders accept-ride cards. Reproduce: /driver → tap online pill → cards should appear.

Once driver toggle works, retest end-to-end: passenger requests → driver goes online → taps accept-ride-{id} → active screen shows pin-input-{passengerId} and verify-pin-{passengerId} → correct PIN marks Boarded → complete-ride-btn returns to /driver.
Verify matching screen renders pin-display and share-trip-btn after driver accepts (currently unverified).
Optional: rename hub picker option testIDs from 'hub-hub-{id}' to 'hub-option-{id}' for clarity.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is a single 471-line file; acceptable for MVP but consider splitting routes into modules once features grow.
server.py uses deprecated @app.on_event('startup')/(shutdown') — migrate to FastAPI lifespan handlers.
Fare recompute logic is clean, but rounding via round(total/n) can cause ₹1 gaps between total_fare and sum of shares; acceptable for MVP.

success_rate.frontend: ~70% (passenger flow verified; driver active flow blocked by toggle bug)

seed_data_creation: TEST_ prefixed users created via /api/auth/register during pytest run (idempotent).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend fully green. Frontend passenger flow verified. Driver online-toggle needs fix before retest. Hub picker option testID pattern is 'hub-hub-{hubId}'. Phone must be exactly 10 digits — use numeric-only phones in playwright (uuid hex breaks validation).
rca_of_issue: Driver online-toggle click issued by Playwright with force=True did not flip state. Screenshot confirms pill still reads 'Offline' post-click. Since /rides/available count is being polled and rendered (shows '1'), fetching works — this is purely a toggle button state binding issue in driver/index.tsx. Likely candidates: (a) onPress not wired to state setter, (b) Pressable wrapped by a non-forwarding component consuming the event, or (c) toggle needs to await async storage/user hydration before enabling. Recommend inspecting driver/index.tsx toggle handler and ensuring setOnline(prev=>!prev) fires unconditionally.
